name: agentpeers
description: The AgentPeers local connection: Claude Code ↔ Codex sessions.

interface.shortDescription: Connect Claude Code and Codex sessions
interface.longDescription: Let Claude Code and Codex ask each other questions, share findings and exchange replies in their existing sessions. Supports Claude Code terminal sessions with Codex terminal or compatible desktop chats on the same Mac; Python 3.10+ required. AgentPeers also offers a separate Grokbot ↔ Dot connection preview, deployed in your Cloudflare account or on your own server. Installing this plugin sets up the local connection.
